UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

We find that no plausible reason is given for condonation of 16:45:13 IST Reason:
delay of 1024 days in filing this petition.
We are, therefore, not inclined to condone the delay.

2. In any case, the direction that is issued by the Division Bench is only to pay compensation as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: No interference is also warranted on merits of the case.
3. The special leave petition is, accordingly, dismissed on the ground of delay as well as on merits.
4. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
